item.title: Youth report: Stags U18 2-2 Lincoln U18
item.description: Goals from forward Zidan Ali and full-back Charlie Cheetham helped Mansfield Town under-18s to a valuable point against Lincoln City on Saturday in the Youth Alliance League. The young Stags raced into the lead after five minutes with Ali firing home before Cheetham doubled the advantage nine minutes before the interval.
